Solution 1 has the correct final answer.

The established result for the depth of $S/J(C_n)^{(t)}$ for the cover ideal of a cycle graph $C_n$ is $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor$.

Solution 1 proposes the formula:
$$\operatorname{depth} S/J(C_n)^{(t)}=\left\lceil \frac{n-1}{2}\right\rceil$$
This formula is mathematically equivalent to $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor$:
\begin{itemize}
    \item If $n=2k$ (even), $\lceil (2k-1)/2 \rceil = \lceil k - 1/2 \rceil = k = n/2$. $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor = k$. (Matches)
    \item If $n=2k+1$ (odd), $\lceil (2k)/2 \rceil = k$. $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor = k$. (Matches)
\end{itemize}
The checks provided in Solution 1 ($n=3 \to 1$, $n=4 \to 2$) confirm this result.

Solution 2 proposes $\lceil n/3 \rceil$. This fails for $n=6$: Solution 2 predicts $\lceil 6/3 \rceil = 2$, but the correct depth is $\lfloor 6/2 \rfloor = 3$.

Solution 3 proposes $\lceil (n-1)/3 \rceil$. This fails for $n=4$: Solution 3 predicts $\lceil 3/3 \rceil = 1$, but the correct depth is $\lfloor 4/2 \rfloor = 2$.

CHOICE: 1
